def format_time(time: mod_datetime.datetime) ->str:
    if time is None:
        return ''
    
    # Handle timezone
    if time.tzinfo is None:
        # No timezone, add Z for UTC
        tz_str = 'Z'
    elif isinstance(time.tzinfo, SimpleTZ):
        # Custom timezone
        offset = time.tzinfo.offset
        if offset == 0:
            tz_str = 'Z'
        else:
            hours = offset // 60
            minutes = abs(offset % 60)
            if hours < 0:
                sign = '-'
                hours = -hours
            else:
                sign = '+'
            tz_str = f'{sign}{hours:02d}:{minutes:02d}'
    else:
        # Other timezone types, try to get offset
        offset = time.utcoffset()
        if offset is None:
            tz_str = 'Z'
        else:
            total_minutes = int(offset.total_seconds() // 60)
            if total_minutes == 0:
                tz_str = 'Z'
            else:
                hours = total_minutes // 60
                minutes = abs(total_minutes % 60)
                if hours < 0:
                    sign = '-'
                    hours = -hours
                else:
                    sign = '+'
                tz_str = f'{sign}{hours:02d}:{minutes:02d}'
    
    # Format the date/time part
    # Always include 6 digits for microseconds, even if zero
    if time.microsecond:
        microsecond_str = f'.{time.microsecond:06d}'
    else:
        microsecond_str = ''
    
    # Create the basic timestamp
    timestamp = f'{time.year:04d}-{time.month:02d}-{time.day:02d}T{time.hour:02d}:{time.minute:02d}:{time.second:02d}{microsecond_str}{tz_str}'
    
    return timestamp
